info.title: XChain Encoder API
info.description: Stateless JSON-RPC 2.0 service (POST /) that builds unsigned PSBTs embedding XChain ACTION payloads into BTC/LTC/DOGE transactions. One instance per chain. The public deployment is path-routed per coin: https://encoder.xchain.io/{COIN}/ (COIN = BTC/TBTC, LTC/TLTC, DOGE/TDOGE). Auth is optional: when the operator configures an API key, requests need an x-api-key header; the public instances run open. Errors follow JSON-RPC 2.0 ({code, message}): -32602 invalid params, -32603 internal, -32001 unauthorized, -32029 rate limited. See the registry at https://docs.xchain.io/protocol/Error_Codes.md. LLM-friendly docs: https://docs.xchain.io/llms.txt

methods.name: ping
methods.summary: Health check; reports the running encoder version.

methods.name: health
methods.summary: Probe hard dependencies (UTXO tracker) and report reachability and sync state.
methods.description: Unlike ping, a health failure means the encoder cannot serve requests correctly. When the tracker is unreachable the fields stay at their defaults (false / null).

tracker_synced.description: tracker is serveable: synced, inside our lag bounds on both sides, not halted, and mempool-reconverged

tracker_lag.description: tracker block lag, or null when unknown/unreachable; negative means the tracker is ahead of the node

tracker_halted.description: tracker stopped polling on an unrecoverable reorg

tracker_mempool_ready.description: tracker has reconverged its mempool, so an already-spent confirmed output can be filtered out

methods.name: estimate_fee
methods.summary: Suggested fee tiers in base-units per vByte (sat/koinu/litoshi) from the node's estimatesmartfee.

methods.name: create_tx
methods.summary: Build an unsigned PSBT embedding an XChain ACTION payload. The caller signs and broadcasts.
methods.description: Encoding auto-selects OP_RETURN for payloads ≤76 bytes, else P2SH (two-transaction flow: call once for the funding tx, then again with p2shHash/p2shHex to build the reveal tx). rawData is decoded as Latin-1 so arbitrary bytes round-trip losslessly. Dogecoin has no segwit: P2WSH and TAPROOT encodings are rejected on DOGE networks. encoding:"TAPROOT" (BTC/LTC, explicit only) is a single-call two-transaction flow: the result carries the commit PSBT (psbt), the pre-built reveal PSBT (revealPsbt) and an `envelope` recovery record ({commitTxid, commitVout, commitValue, commitAddress, internalPubkey, tapleafHash, controlBlock, revealFee}) that the wallet must persist durably BEFORE broadcasting the commit; sign both, broadcast commit then reveal. TAPROOT requires compressedPubKey (the envelope internal key), segwit-only inputs, and accepts payloads up to the 400,000-byte envelope ceiling.

schema.description: sender address (or public key for compressed flows)
ACTION payload string (pipe-delimited, from xchain-sdk createAction)
additional raw bytes, Latin-1 decoded (gated-FILE ciphertext, ECIES envelopes)
explicit UTXOs; fetched from the UTXO tracker when omitted (max 500)
extra outputs [{address, value}] (max 100); value is base units, pass amounts above 2^53-1 as an exact decimal string
protocol fee output {address, amount} from the hub/indexer fee quote
absolute fee in base units (rejected if over the fee-rate cap)
fee rate in base units per kB (clamped to the fee-rate cap)
dust threshold override
signal replace-by-fee
allow spending unconfirmed UTXOs

force a carrier, or "AUTO" to let the encoder pick the smallest-footprint one this network and signer support (OP_RETURN for payloads that fit one output, else TAPROOT where available, else P2WSH, else P2SH). AUTO is an OPT-IN because it can resolve to TAPROOT, which returns a commit/reveal PAIR instead of one PSBT. Omitting encoding keeps the legacy behaviour (OP_RETURN, else P2SH) unchanged.
change address (defaults to sender)
funding txid: switches to the P2SH/P2WSH reveal (tx2) flow
funding tx raw hex (required with p2shHash)
compressed public key when pubkey is an address

transparent FILE payload compression (deflate-raw, kept only when it is smaller and within the 150:1 guard), which appends the COMPRESSION field to a FILE v0 ACTION string. ON BY DEFAULT: omit this to take the deployment default, pass false to opt out. An EXPLICIT true that cannot be honoured is an error (a non-FILE action has nowhere to record the marker; a token-gated FILE's COMPRESSION means inflate-after-decrypt and belongs to the client that compressed before encrypting; an action that already declares a codec is never re-compressed). The default pass simply rides raw in those cases and says why in the result.

per-call capabilities. signerSupportsTapscript (boolean, default false) tells AUTO whether this caller can sign a tapscript script-path spend; without it AUTO never selects TAPROOT, because the reveal must be signable before the commit is broadcast. Unknown keys are refused.

psbt.description: unsigned PSBT, hex (the commit PSBT for TAPROOT)

encoding.description: encoding actually used (the resolved carrier when AUTO was requested)

compression.description: present whenever compression ran: {compressed, rawLength, storedLength, reason}. reason names why a payload rode raw (not-a-file-action, gated-file, codec-already-declared, not-smaller, ratio-guard, over-input-cap, deflate-failed).

revealPsbt.description: TAPROOT only: pre-built reveal PSBT, hex

envelope.description: TAPROOT only: recovery record to persist before broadcasting the commit

warnings.description: present only when the built transaction carries a caveat the caller should see before signing; each entry is {code, message}. RAWDATA_ONLY_NOT_DECODED: rawData sent without data compiles to an OP_0-led payload that current decoders read as empty, so the transaction confirms and the fee is paid but the payload is not indexed as an ACTION.

methods.name: create_envelope_cancel_tx
methods.summary: Build the key-path cancel PSBT sweeping an unrevealed TAPROOT envelope commit back to the caller.
methods.description: Rebuilds the sweep from the persisted recovery record alone; the PSBT carries tapInternalKey and tapMerkleRoot so the signer can compute the BIP341 tweak. The cancel conflicts with the reveal by construction (same outpoint): treat it as a replacement of the reveal.

schema.description: commit transaction id (64-char hex)
commit output index
commit output value in base units
envelope internal key: 66-char compressed or 64-char x-only hex
BIP341 tapleaf hash of the envelope script (64-char hex); the single-leaf merkle root
address to sweep the commit value to
fee rate in base units per kB (clamped to the fee-rate cap)
signal replace-by-fee

methods.name: broadcast_tx
methods.summary: Broadcast a signed raw transaction to the coin node.

schema.description: signed raw transaction hex

methods.summary: List UTXOs for an address (proxied from xchain-utxo-tracker).
